# [0.5.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.4.1...v0.5.0) (2026-10-22)


### Features

* **schema:** zod at the tool + viewer input boundaries; ISO ts validation at the store reader ([4a066d1](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/4a066d10a658979c6132f3e80723b72c1c662fca)), closes [#21](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/21) [#15](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/15)

issues.title: persistent prompt injection: framing + provenance for injected memory blocks; stricter import policy
viewer: malformed Host header throws before the guard — Bun dev error page discloses stack/paths
First writes after a service restart stamp the server launch dir as repo, making rows invisible in the real repo
viewer /api/restore joins raw body.name — files outside the store can be promoted into memory
write gate DoS: uncapped content length x super-linear PATH_RE (100KB -> 6s, 2MB -> hang)
store: validate ts shape at read time (row identity must not be an arbitrary string)
